name: Chris Swanson
title: Principal GenAI Security Architect
tagline: Security architect and engineer: systems thinking, AI security, and building teams that ship.
summary: Security architect and engineer with fifteen years across fintech, identity, media and data companies. I design and build security for distributed systems, cloud and code-defined infrastructure, and enterprise architecture, and I now lead security architecture for GenAI and agentic systems. I focus on delivering against critical roadmap milestones, and on mentoring junior and mid-career engineers.

experience.summary: Leading technical strategy, security governance and architectural hardening for enterprise AI/ML workloads, agentic systems and their tooling, and setting scalable patterns for secure AI adoption.
highlights: Infrastructure Knowledge Graphs & MCP Architecture: Architected and deployed knowledge graphs alongside Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and custom skill registries, empowering internal engineering teams to map complex dependencies and extract deep operational insights across existing services and processes.

Scalable Threat Modeling & Agent-Driven Reviews: Spearheaded security reviews and threat modeling for high-velocity AI/ML application deployments; engineered agent-driven review pipelines to automate assessment workflows and systematically scale security oversight across distributed microservices.

AI Enablement & Runtime Governance: Accelerated enterprise AI capabilities through the secure deployment of specialized runtime software, orchestration frameworks, and centralized lifecycle management for agent skills and tool definitions.

AI/ML Application Architecture & Standardization: Established comprehensive architectural patterns and security baselines specifically tailored to GenAI use cases, multi-agent coordination, and high-risk data processing boundaries.

Technical Enablement & Capability Building: Fostered a culture of secure innovation by designing and leading targeted training programs, workshops, and recurring technical office hours to upskill engineering and security teams on modern AI paradigms and secure system design.
